newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa plane slightly damaged in landing.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa plane slightly damaged in landing.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said one of its Airbus A-320 aircraft was slightly damaged on Friday after the aircraft's tail scraped the runway during landing at Duesseldorf airport.
None of the 69 passengers and five crew aboard the flight from Hamburg to Duesseldorf was injured, the airline said.
The impact scraped paint and some metal off the tail of the aircraft, a Lufthansa spokesman said. The exact reason for the so-called "tail strike" was not yet known.
Lufthansa said the aircraft has been taken out of service for inspection.
